Naya username daala... already taken! Doosra daala... ye bhi taken! Par ruko... do sau crore users mein check, itni jaldi kaise hua?
Yahi concept Amazon ke SDE One interview mein poocha jaata hai: HashMap andar se kaise kaam karta hai? Aur package? Pehle saal ka lagbhag pachchees lakh!
Normal tareeka: list mein har user ek-ek karke check karo. Aarav? Nahi. Priya? Nahi. Rohan? Nahi... Do sau crore users, matlab har signup pe do sau crore checks! Server ka dhuaan nikal jaayega!
Smart tareeka: Hashing! Username ko hash function mein daalo. Wo ek number deta hai, bucket ka address. Rahul ka hash aaya chaar... seedha bucket chaar kholo... Rahul mil gaya! Taken!
Aur rahul underscore twenty twenty-six? Hash aaya saat. Bucket saat khaali hai... Available!
Do sau crore users... aur check sirf ek! Time, O of one!
Interviewer ka follow-up: do usernames ka hash same aa gaya toh? Ise kehte hain collision. Us bucket mein ek chhoti list bana do!
Ek line mein yaad rakho: hash nikaalo, seedha bucket pe jao, O of one! Comment karo, tumhara kaunsa username taken tha? Aur pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karo!
